detail.title: 4MP 25x Starlight IR WizSense Network PTZ Camera
detail.overview: Compare Favourite SD4A425DB-HNY 4MP 25x Starlight IR WizSense Network PTZ Camera Key Points • High-Quality Imaging with 4MP Resolution • 25× Optical Zoom Provide Close Up Views Over Expansive Areas • Expansive Night View With up to 100 m IR Distance for 24/7 Monitoring • Optional Smoked Dome Cover & In-Ceiling Mount for Enhanced Concealment • Deep Learning-Based Human and Vehicle Classification • Face Detection：Leveraging Facial Data to Enhance Analytics Accuracy • Human tracking based on Auto Tracking 1.0 technology • IP66 & TVS 6000V Protection with Lightning/Surge/Voltage Transient Resistance Sales Enquiry Datasheet

General.Pan/Tilt Range: Pan: 0° to 360° endless Tilt: –5° to +90°, auto flip 180°
General.IVS (Perimeter Protection): Tripwire; intrusion; crossing fence detection; loitering detection; abandoned/missing object; fast moving; parking detection; people gathering; vehicle/human alarm classification; linkage tracking
General.Face Detection: Supports face detection, face track box, capturing pictures, face enhancement; Supports face cutout: Face, one-inch photo. Capturing strategies include real-time capturing and quality first
General.Auto Patrol: It triggers the IVS rule when a target is detected and makes the camera link with the PTZ to rotate to the position of the target and patrol based on its presets
General.Video Compression: H.264H; H.264B; Smart H.265+; H.264; H.265; MJPEG(Sub Stream); Smart H.264+
General.Video Frame Rate: Main stream: 4M/3M/1080p/1.3M/720p @(1–25/30 fps) Sub stream 1: D1/VGA/CIF@ (1–25/30 fps) Sub stream 2: 720p/CIF @(1–25/30 fps)
General.White Balance: Auto; indoor; outdoor; ATW; manual; sodium lamp; natural light; street lamp
General.Privacy Masking: Up to 24 areas can be set, with up to 8 areas in the same view
General.Audio Compression: G.711a; G.711Mu; G.726; MPEG2-Layer2; G722.1; PCM
General.Network Protocol: FTP; RTMP; IPv6; Bonjour; IPv4; DNS; RTCP; PPPoE; NTP; RTP; 802.1x; HTTPS; SNMP; TCP/IP; DDNS; UPnP; NFS; ICMP; UDP; IGMP; HTTP; SSL; DHCP; SMTP; Qos; RTSP; ARP; ;SAMBA
General.Interoperability: CGI; SDK; ONVIF (Profile S & Profile G & Profile T & Profile M); P2P
General.Storage: Micro SD card (512 GB); FTP/SFTP; NAS
General.Browser: IE 9 and later versions Chrome 41 and later versions Firefox 50 and later versions iOS 10 and later versions
General.Certifications: CE: EN55032/EN55024/EN50130-4 FCC: Part15 subpartB, ANSI C63.4-2014 UL: UL62368-1
General.Alarm Linkage: Capture; preset; tour; pattern; recordings on SD card; alarm digital input; send email
General.Alarm Event: Motion/Tampering detection; audio detection; network disconnection detection; IP conflict detection; memory card state detection; memory space detection
General.Alarm Input: 2 channels in: supports wet contact connection (max load 5 mA 3–5 VDC); supports dry contact connection
General.Alarm Output: 1 channel out: dry contact, max load 1,000 mA 30 VDC/500 mA 50 VAC
General.Power Consumption: Basic: 9.5 W Max(illuminator on + fan on + PTZ): 21.5 W
General.Protection: IP66, TVS 6000 V lightning proof; surge protection; voltage transient protection
